_zelenszki_: Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki came from Lindenbruck, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Verdel Ridge is lost. Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A bullet went through Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki's sleeve at S-F16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Clement "Lucky" Johnrant of the Concord (@johnrant21). After what happened at the Brickworks, Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki asked to serve as a stretcher bearer. Nobody argued.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki is whole again, or near enough for the line.
mitaylor_1776: Bram "Crow" Mitaylor arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a dented harmonica and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Bram "Crow" Mitaylor received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
Bram "Crow" Mitaylor started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
seths110: Ulrich Seths arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a photograph gone soft at the edges and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Ulrich Seths made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Seths. Ulrich Seths read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
spencerbonthoux: The new rifleman gave his name as Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
The men have learned that Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth is always the first one awake. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.

Thunder shook dust from the beams over Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth. The man beside him asked whether the sky had the correct range. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.

Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth was hit through the chest at R-F11. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Teodor Acakostic of the Hegemony (@acakostic11). Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. The worst has passed for Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly.
topekeno: Felix Topekeno arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
First Wave. Felix Topekeno signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts.

Bastian "Lucky" Vpy held the mirror while Felix Topekeno shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Felix Topekeno watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Felix Topekeno tried to remember the price of a loaf in Wyvern Cross. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Felix Topekeno approved the method.
